review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Iterative DFS computes low-link values and subtree intervals. Removing a vertex disconnects precisely child subtrees whose low>=tin[removed]; all remaining vertices share the parent-side component. Binary search finds the direct child containing each endpoint, including root and ancestor cases. Compare component IDs per query in logarithmic time.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
